name: Snub-fighter
description: Snub-fighter was a term used to describe small starfighters such as the Z-95 Headhunter, its successor, the T-65B X-wing starfighter, the BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber, the B-wing, the TIE/fo space superiority fighter, and the TIE/sf space superiority fighter.
